source.name: NASA Exoplanet Archive Planetary Systems Composite Parameters
source.query:
select
  pl_name,
  hostname,
  hd_name,
  hip_name,
  tic_id,
  ra,
  dec,
  sy_dist,
  sy_pnum,
  sy_snum,
  sy_mnum,
  st_rad,
  st_teff,
  st_mass,
  st_spectype,
  pl_rade,
  pl_bmasse,
  pl_orbper,
  pl_orbsmax,
  discoverymethod,
  disc_year
from pscomppars
where hostname is not null
  and ra is not null
  and dec is not null
  and sy_dist is not null
order by hostname, pl_name
